constraints.scenario_tool_annotation: Only static write tools are listed inside scenarios. Static reads are not annotated.

scenarios.title: Delayed order, frustrated customer
flow: Customer says the order has been taking much longer than expected and asks where it is.
Agent confirms the order ID.
Customer confirms.
Agent gives the known order status and ETA.
Customer complains that they have already been waiting a long time.
Agent acknowledges the frustration and reassures them using only the known status and ETA.

scenarios.title: Customer repeatedly checks whether delayed food is actually coming
flow: Customer says the app has not seemed to change for a while.
Agent confirms the order ID.
Customer confirms.
Agent gives the known status and ETA.
Customer asks whether the order is definitely still on the way.
Agent reassures them without claiming to contact the rider or restaurant.

scenarios.title: Cold and soggy food complaint with refund request
flow: Customer says the delivered food was cold and soggy.
Agent confirms the order ID and acknowledges the poor experience.
Customer explains which items were affected.
Customer asks for a refund.
Agent submits the refund request.
Agent confirms that the refund has been requested without inventing an amount or timeline.

scenarios.title: Missing item from delivered order
flow: Customer says one item is missing from the delivery.
Agent confirms the order ID.
Customer confirms.
Agent verifies that the missing item was part of the order.
Customer asks for a refund for the issue.
Agent submits and confirms the refund request.

scenarios.title: Order status followed by delivery instruction
flow: Customer asks where the order is.
Agent confirms the order ID and gives the known status and ETA.
Customer says they are in a meeting and asks the rider not to ring the bell.
Customer asks for a call instead.
Agent adds the instruction and confirms the final wording.

scenarios.title: Customer has moved location and changes delivery details
flow: Customer asks for the current ETA.
Agent provides the known ETA.
Customer realizes they will no longer be at the current delivery address.
Customer provides their office address.
Agent updates and confirms the new address.
Customer also provides a different contact number.
Agent updates and confirms the new number.

scenarios.title: Address, landmark and delivery instruction changed together
flow: Customer says the delivery address needs correcting.
Customer gives the corrected address, including tower and flat number.
Agent updates and confirms the address.
Customer adds a landmark and asks the rider to call from the gate.
Agent records and confirms the instruction.

scenarios.title: Customer corrects address while dictating it
flow: Customer asks to change the delivery address.
Customer begins giving the new address.
Customer immediately corrects the flat number while speaking.
Agent uses only the corrected final address.
Agent updates the address and echoes the final version.

scenarios.title: Order is still preparing and customer cancels due to delay
flow: Customer asks for the current status.
Agent confirms the order ID and says the order is still preparing.
Customer is annoyed by the delay and says they no longer want it.
Agent confirms the cancellation request.
Agent cancels the order and confirms completion.

scenarios.title: Contact number and delivery instruction changed for another receiver
flow: Customer says a family member will receive the food.
Customer gives that person's phone number.
Agent updates and confirms the number.
Customer asks the rider to call when downstairs instead of ringing.
Agent records and confirms the instruction.

scenarios.title: Customer checks order contents before delivery
flow: Customer asks whether a specific side and drink are included in the order.
Agent confirms the order ID.
Customer confirms.
Agent tells them the known item list and quantities.
Customer asks one short follow-up about the total amount.
Agent gives the known order total.

scenarios.title: Incorrect delivery instruction needs replacement
flow: Customer asks what delivery instruction is currently attached to the order.
Agent tells them the existing instruction.
Customer says that instruction is wrong and provides a replacement.
Agent updates the instruction.
Agent repeats the new instruction back clearly.

scenarios.title: Food quality complaint with emotional conversation
flow: Customer says the meal arrived very late and is now barely edible.
Agent acknowledges the frustration and asks what was wrong with the food.
Customer explains that the fries are cold and the packaging is wet.
Agent responds empathetically without claiming to investigate live systems.
Customer asks for a refund request.
Agent submits and confirms it.

scenarios.title: Customer needs package before travelling
flow: Customer says they are travelling soon and asks when the package will arrive.
Agent confirms the order ID.
Customer confirms.
Agent gives the known delivery date and status.
Customer asks whether the date means it should arrive before their trip.
Agent restates the known date without making additional guarantees.

scenarios.title: Expensive order causing anxiety
flow: Customer says the order is expensive and they are worried because they have not received it yet.
Agent confirms the order ID.
Agent gives the known shipment status and delivery date.
Customer asks which exact product variant they ordered.
Agent confirms the known variant and payment details.

scenarios.title: Wrong product variant leads to cancellation
flow: Customer asks whether they ordered the 128 GB or 256 GB variant.
Agent tells them the stored variant.
Customer realizes they selected the wrong version.
Customer asks to cancel the order.
Agent cancels it and confirms completion.

scenarios.title: Old delivery address discovered
flow: Customer asks which address the package is being delivered to.
Agent gives the stored address.
Customer realizes it is their previous residence.
Customer dictates the new address.
Agent updates and confirms it.

scenarios.title: Recently moved customer updates address and phone
flow: Customer says both the delivery address and contact number are outdated.
Customer provides the new address.
Agent updates and confirms it.
Customer provides the new phone number.
Agent updates and confirms the number.

scenarios.title: Office delivery requires security instructions
flow: Customer says the package is going to an office building.
Customer explains that delivery personnel cannot enter upstairs.
Customer asks for the parcel to be left with security and for them to be called.
Agent records and confirms the instruction.

scenarios.title: Family member will receive the package
flow: Customer says they will not be home during delivery.
Customer gives a family member's phone number.
Agent updates and confirms the number.
Customer asks the delivery person to hand the package to that family member.
Agent records and confirms the instruction.

scenarios.title: Damaged product complaint
flow: Customer says the package arrived with damaged packaging and the product is broken.
Agent confirms the order ID and product.
Customer describes the damage and expresses frustration.
Agent acknowledges the problem.
Customer asks for a refund.
Agent submits and confirms the refund request.

scenarios.title: Returned item, customer wants refund
flow: Customer asks about the return status of an item they already sent back.
Agent gives the known return status.
Customer says they now want the refund request raised.
Agent submits the request.
Agent confirms without inventing a refund amount or timeline.

scenarios.title: Delivery date is too late for an occasion
flow: Customer says the item was meant as a birthday gift.
Customer asks when it will arrive.
Agent gives the known delivery date.
Customer says the birthday is before that date and asks to cancel.
Agent cancels the order and confirms it.

scenarios.title: Customer gradually remembers which product they bought
flow: Customer cannot remember the exact product name and describes it casually.
Agent confirms the order ID.
Customer provides the ID.
Agent tells them the product name, colour or variant, order status and delivery date.
Customer confirms that this is what they were looking for.

scenarios.title: Frustrated customer wants only concise factual answers
flow: Customer says they have already spent too much time dealing with the order.
Customer asks only where the package is and when it should arrive.
Agent gives the status and known delivery date concisely.
Customer asks which phone number is attached to delivery.
Agent answers directly without unnecessary explanation.

scenarios.title: Customer corrects delivery address while dictating it
flow: Customer asks to change their delivery address.
Customer gives the street and building details.
Customer notices they gave the wrong apartment number and corrects it.
Agent uses the final corrected address only.
Agent updates and confirms the full address.

scenarios.title: Late cab while customer is rushing to airport
flow: Customer says the cab is late and they are worried about missing their flight.
Agent confirms the ride ID.
Customer confirms.
Agent gives the known ride status and ETA.
Customer expresses anxiety about the delay.
Agent calmly reassures them using only the known ride information.

scenarios.title: Customer repeatedly asks whether cab is actually coming
flow: Customer says they have been waiting and asks whether the cab is still arriving.
Agent gives the known status and ETA.
Customer asks for the driver's name and vehicle number.
Agent provides both.
Customer says they are worried because they cannot see the vehicle yet.
Agent reiterates the known information without pretending to contact the driver.

scenarios.title: Airport pickup point changes
flow: Customer says they have moved from the original terminal pickup point.
Customer provides the new gate.
Agent changes the pickup location.
Agent confirms the new pickup point.

scenarios.title: Pickup location and phone number both change
flow: Customer says they are now waiting at a different airport gate.
Customer asks to change the pickup location.
Agent updates and confirms it.
Customer says their primary phone has poor network and provides another number.
Agent updates and confirms the number.

scenarios.title: Pickup location plus detailed driver instruction
flow: Customer changes pickup to the side entrance of a hotel.
Agent updates the pickup location.
Customer explains that the driver should wait outside the security barrier.
Agent records the instruction.
Agent confirms both the final pickup and instruction.

scenarios.title: Customer changes destination
flow: Customer says they now need to go to their office instead of home.
Customer gives the new destination.
Agent changes the drop location.
Agent repeats the final destination for confirmation.

scenarios.title: Pickup and destination both entered incorrectly
flow: Customer checks the pickup and drop details.
Agent tells them the stored locations.
Customer realizes both are incorrect and provides the correct pickup.
Agent updates it.
Customer gives the correct destination.
Agent updates it and confirms both final locations.

scenarios.title: Customer feels uncomfortable during ride
flow: Customer says something about the driver's behaviour is making them uncomfortable.
Agent takes the concern seriously and prioritizes the customer's safety.
Agent tells them to use the in-app SOS or safety feature if available.
Agent advises them to contact emergency services if they believe they are in immediate danger.
Agent does not minimize the concern or make unsupported claims about monitoring the ride.

scenarios.title: Customer is worried because route feels unfamiliar
flow: Customer says the driver is taking roads they do not recognize and they feel unsafe.
Agent acknowledges the concern.
Agent recommends using the app's safety or SOS functionality.
Agent advises contacting emergency services if they feel they are in immediate danger.
Agent avoids claiming access to live route information that is not in the prompt.

scenarios.title: Customer cannot identify the arriving cab
flow: Customer says there are many cars around and they cannot tell which one is theirs.
Agent confirms the ride ID.
Agent gives the driver's name, vehicle number and known pickup location.
Customer repeats the vehicle number to verify.
Agent confirms it.

scenarios.title: Ride booked for elderly parent
flow: Customer says their parent will be taking the ride.
Customer provides the parent's phone number.
Agent updates and confirms it.
Customer asks the driver to call when arriving and wait near the entrance.
Agent records and confirms the instruction.

scenarios.title: Major delay leads to cancellation
flow: Customer complains that the cab is taking too long.
Agent gives the known status and ETA.
Customer says they will arrange another ride and asks to cancel this one.
Agent cancels the ride.
Agent confirms cancellation.

scenarios.title: Fare disagreement followed by refund request
flow: Customer says they remember a different fare and asks what amount is recorded.
Agent gives the known fare and payment method.
Customer remains dissatisfied and asks for a refund request.
Agent submits the request.
Agent confirms the request without inventing a calculated refund amount.

scenarios.title: Wrong office branch entered as destination
flow: Customer asks what drop location is on the ride.
Agent provides it.
Customer realizes they entered the wrong office branch.
Customer provides the correct location.
Agent updates and confirms the destination.

scenarios.title: Another family member will take the ride
flow: Customer says their sister will take the ride instead.
Customer gives the sister's phone number.
Agent updates it.
Customer adjusts the pickup location slightly.
Agent updates it.
Customer asks for an instruction identifying the passenger.
Agent records and confirms all final details.

scenarios.title: Passenger has heavy luggage and needs precise pickup
flow: Customer asks for the driver and vehicle details.
Agent gives the known details.
Customer says they have large suitcases and asks the driver to stop near the trolley area.
Agent records the instruction and confirms it.

scenarios.title: Unexpected charge complaint
flow: Customer says they noticed a charge and want to understand what it is for.
Agent confirms the account.
Agent gives the current plan, price and renewal date.
Customer says they did not realize the subscription had renewed.
Agent explains only the known billing facts.

scenarios.title: Unexpected renewal followed by cancellation
flow: Customer asks why they were charged.
Agent explains the known plan and renewal details.
Customer says they barely use the service and does not want another renewal.
Customer asks to cancel.
Agent cancels the subscription and confirms it.

scenarios.title: Customer is frustrated about paying for unused service
flow: Customer complains that they have barely used the service for months.
Customer asks how much they are paying and when the next renewal is.
Agent provides the known billing information.
Customer asks to cancel the subscription.
Agent cancels and confirms it.

scenarios.title: Customer is temporarily away and pauses subscription
flow: Customer says they will not be using the service for some time.
Customer asks whether the subscription is currently active.
Agent confirms the status.
Customer asks to pause it.
Agent pauses the subscription and confirms the action.

scenarios.title: Phone number and email both outdated
flow: Customer says both contact details on the account are old.
Customer gives a new phone number.
Agent updates and confirms it.
Customer gives a new email address.
Agent updates and confirms that as well.

scenarios.title: Customer cannot remember registered email
flow: Customer asks which email address is attached to the account.
Agent provides the appropriate known account detail.
Customer says they no longer use that email and provides a new one.
Agent updates and confirms it.

scenarios.title: Renewal leads to cancellation and refund request
flow: Customer asks when the plan renewed.
Agent gives the known renewal details.
Customer says they did not intend to continue the subscription.
Customer asks to cancel it.
Agent cancels the subscription.
Customer also asks for a refund.
Agent submits the refund request and confirms both actions.

scenarios.title: Parent now manages the account
flow: Customer explains that their parent now primarily uses the account.
Customer asks which phone number is currently registered.
Agent provides the known account information.
Customer provides the parent's number.
Agent updates and confirms it.

scenarios.title: Customer wants a very concise answer
flow: Customer says they have already contacted support and do not want a long explanation.
Customer asks only for the current plan price and next renewal date.
Agent answers both directly.
Customer asks whether the subscription is active.
Agent answers concisely.

scenarios.title: Customer misunderstands billing frequency
flow: Customer says they thought the subscription was billed monthly.
Agent tells them the actual known billing cycle and amount.
Customer asks when the next renewal happens.
Agent provides the renewal date.
Customer realizes the misunderstanding and ends the call.

scenarios.title: Refund request after frustrating charge
flow: Customer is upset about a recent subscription charge.
Agent confirms the known billing amount and renewal date.
Customer explains that they no longer use the service.
Customer asks for a refund request.
Agent submits and confirms it without promising approval or a specific amount.

scenarios.title: Contact update followed by cancellation
flow: Customer says the phone number attached to the account is old.
Customer provides a new phone number.
Agent updates it.
Customer then says they also want the subscription cancelled.
Agent cancels it and confirms both actions.

scenarios.title: Customer checks account before deciding what to do
flow: Customer asks which plan they have, how much it costs and when it renews.
Agent provides the three known facts.
Customer complains that the price feels high.
Agent acknowledges the frustration without pushing a particular action.
No write is performed.

scenarios.title: Late and anxious passenger asks for gate and boarding time
flow: Passenger arrives at the counter in a hurry and says they may be late.
Agent confirms the PNR.
Passenger confirms.
Agent gives the known gate, boarding time and departure time.
Passenger asks whether boarding has enough time remaining.
Agent clearly restates the known timings without inventing live operational information.

scenarios.title: Passenger confused between boarding and departure time
flow: Passenger asks whether the time on their ticket is boarding time or departure time.
Agent confirms the booking.
Agent explains the stored boarding and departure times separately.
Passenger repeats the boarding time to make sure they understood.
Agent confirms.

scenarios.title: Elderly passenger needs slow, clear guidance
flow: Passenger asks for the gate and seat details and seems confused.
Agent explains the gate, boarding time and seat slowly and clearly.
Passenger asks again which terminal they need.
Agent repeats the terminal concisely and politely.

scenarios.title: Passenger checks seat and whether it is a window seat
flow: Passenger asks for their seat number.
Agent confirms the booking and gives the seat.
Passenger asks whether it is a window or aisle seat.
Agent answers from the known seat metadata.

scenarios.title: Passenger anxious about baggage allowance
flow: Passenger says they have several bags and are worried about the allowance.
Agent confirms the booking.
Agent gives the known checked baggage and cabin baggage allowances.
Passenger asks one follow-up to make sure the two limits are separate.
Agent clarifies them.

scenarios.title: Passenger wants to verify checked baggage count
flow: Passenger says they handed over bags and wants to make sure the record is correct.
Agent confirms the booking.
Agent tells them the known checked baggage count.
Passenger confirms that matches what they expected.

scenarios.title: Passenger confused about connecting flight
flow: Passenger says they have an onward connection and are unsure about the next flight.
Agent confirms the booking.
Agent gives the known onward flight number, departure time and terminal.
Passenger asks how the connection fits with the first flight timing.
Agent explains the known itinerary without promising live connection outcomes.

scenarios.title: Passenger does not remember flight number
flow: Passenger gives their PNR and destination but says they cannot remember the flight number.
Agent identifies the booking.
Agent gives the flight number, departure time, terminal and gate.
Passenger confirms they now know where to go.

scenarios.title: Passenger gives wrong PNR and corrects it
flow: Passenger begins giving a PNR.
Passenger realizes they read it incorrectly and gives the corrected PNR.
Agent uses the corrected booking reference.
Passenger asks for the boarding time and gate.
Agent provides the known details.

scenarios.title: International traveller updates phone number
flow: Passenger says the phone number on the booking will not be usable during travel.
Passenger provides another contact number.
Agent updates the number.
Agent repeats the final number for confirmation.

scenarios.title: Passenger updates both phone and email
flow: Passenger says both contact details on the booking are outdated.
Passenger gives a new phone number.
Agent updates and confirms it.
Passenger gives a new email address.
Agent updates and confirms that as well.

scenarios.title: Passenger checks meal preference
flow: Passenger asks whether their requested meal preference is on the booking.
Agent confirms the booking.
Agent tells them the known meal preference.
Passenger asks one clarification about what is currently recorded.
Agent repeats the stored preference without making availability claims.

scenarios.title: Passenger frustrated about itinerary but only needs facts
flow: Passenger complains that the travel schedule is inconvenient.
Agent acknowledges the frustration.
Passenger asks for departure time, boarding time, gate and connection details.
Agent walks through the known information calmly.
No change or dynamic lookup is offered.

scenarios.title: Passenger decides not to travel
flow: Passenger says they will not be able to take the flight.
Agent confirms the PNR and flight details.
Passenger asks for the ticket to be cancelled.
Agent submits the cancellation request.
Agent confirms that the request has been made.

scenarios.title: Ticket cancellation and refund request together
flow: Passenger says they cannot travel and asks to cancel the ticket.
Agent confirms the booking and submits the cancellation request.
Passenger then asks for a refund.
Agent submits the refund request.
Agent confirms both requests without quoting an unknown refund amount or timeline.

scenarios.title: Refund request for already cancelled ticket
flow: Passenger says the ticket has already been cancelled and asks about getting the money back.
Agent confirms the PNR and known booking status.
Passenger explicitly asks for a refund request.
Agent submits the request.
Agent confirms it without inventing approval, amount or processing time.

scenarios.title: Passenger worried about a short connection
flow: Passenger says the connection looks very short and is worried about making it.
Agent gives the known arrival and onward departure times.
Passenger asks for the onward terminal and flight number.
Agent provides them.
Agent acknowledges the concern without claiming the connection is guaranteed.
